title: bridging simulation and experiment: a self-supervised domain adaptation framework for concrete damage classification
core_idea: Combine a virtual testing platform that generates large-scale labeled synthetic coda-wave data via multiscale concrete degradation and ultrasonic simulations with a self-supervised domain adaptation framework (domain adversarial training, minimum class confusion loss, and BYOL) to transfer knowledge from labeled simulations to unlabeled experimental measurements for robust concrete damage classification.
tldr: A simulation-driven, self-supervised domain adaptation approach uses synthetic coda-wave data and joint adversarial/contrastive strategies to reduce reliance on experimental labels and enable reliable damage classification on real-world concrete data.
